 First Look: Jenna Ortega Appears For Interview On Monday’s “Late Night With Seth Meyers”
 The actress supports “Klara and the Sun” on Monday’s broadcast.
 by 
 Brian Cantor 
 Oct 19, 2026, 9:18 pm 
 LATE NIGHT WITH SETH MEYERS -- Episode 1839 -- Pictured: (l-r) Actress Jenna Ortega during an interview with host Seth Meyers on October 19, 2026 -- (Photo by: Lloyd Bishop/NBC) 
 High-profile actress Jenna Ortega makes a late-night television appearance Monday.
 Ortega appears as the lead guest on “Late Night With Seth Meyers.” The visit comes in support of the new film “Klara and the Sun,” which opens in theaters this week.
 Ortega is one of two guests on the broadcast; the episode also features a chat with Ina Garten.
 Filmed in advance, the episode will air at 12:35AM ET/PT on NBC. Prior to the broadcast, the network shared a collection of first-look photos from the taping.
